_doc: Exceptions and remaining-work lists for scripts/ui_parity_rules.py (L1-L10). Every exception carries a reason. `remaining` lists are ratchets: a count may only go down, and must be lowered here when a fix lands.

allow.reason: a menu row and the toast after it, not two wordings of one label (the Qt '…' suffix itself is UI_PARITY_QT.md section e)

L1._doc: Paired screens compared directly: Qt <-> Android and web desktop <-> web phone. A one-sided text that nearly equals a one-sided text of the other side is the same task written two ways. `allow`: a pair that only looks alike (a, b = the two texts), with a reason.

allow.reason: the ban is for the name of the player's '…' sheet; New project's 'Tuỳ chọn' is the heading of its optional settings section (web NewProjectScreen.tsx, Qt NewProjectScreen.qml), not a '…' button
the ban is a countdown under a pairing code; the uses are an export job's time left ('còn 3 phút', bookFileExport.ts / labels.ts / ExportModel.kt), the same words on all three
the ban is a bare size before '· còn trống'; the template's first slot is always 'Sách {cỡ}' or 'Chưa có sách' (format.ts storageSummary = DevicesModel.kt Storage.line), i.e. the chosen wording

L2._doc: Dictionary 'Thay cho' items that only look like a used text: (task, text) with a reason. A row-specific ban that hits an unrelated task goes here, never a whole row.

web_only.reason: CSS data-URI image for the native <select> arrow; Qt and Compose draw the lucide chevron icon
CSS box-shadow list; Qt Shadow.qml and Compose elevation draw their own shadow from the same layer role

allow.reason: Windows title-bar close button: the system's own red (#c42b1c / pressed #a82419) with white glyph, as every Windows app; not an ABook colour
interpolates between two Theme colours frame by frame during the mini <-> full morph (no fixed colour)
reading-surface tokens: Theme.read accent at the surface's own along/word percentages (web color-mix of the same tokens)
edge fade from the reading surface's background token to its transparent self
edge fade from the host's background token to transparent
Theme.warning at 60 % / 25 %: the web's `ring-warning/60` / `ring-warning/25` on the same marked row
shadow cast by the sidebar (web `shadow` token is a CSS box-shadow list, web-only); Qt draws the same soft edge as a gradient
alpha mask (DstIn): only the alpha channel is used, no colour reaches the screen
shadow above the floating mini player (web `shadow` is CSS, web-only); drawn as a gradient

L3._doc: Colour tokens: every tokens.json colour reaches Theme.qml and Tokens.kt except `web_only`. QML/Kotlin UI files use Theme.* / Abook.colors.*; `allow` = (file, exact match) with a reason.

L7._doc: Source candidates, not confirmed defects. Per-file ratchet starts at resume; repairs must lower these counts. Sleep timer work is owned by andfix.
